title: DP775 Diffusion of Technical Change and the Decomposition of Output into Trend and Cycle
title_zh: DP775 技术变革的扩散与产出分解为趋势和周期
authors: Marco Lippi, Lucrezia Reichlin, Alexander Bick, Adam Blandin, David Deming 等
official: 官方在线 1993-05-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper we argue that modelling the trend component in real GNP as a random walk is inconsistent with its interpretation as productivity growth. As an alternative we specify the trend as an Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) process, whose impulse response function follows an S-shaped pattern reflecting the process of diffusion of technical change. Such an ARIMA process is employed to build and estimate an Unobserved Components ARIMA (UCARIMA) model using USA post-war quarterly data. We find that our model, although more parsimonious, fits the data as well as the standard random walk plus AR(2) cycle. Moreover, the cycle has a very low variance relative to the variance of the trend in our model.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，将实际GNP的趋势成分建模为随机游走，与其作为生产率增长的解释相矛盾。作为替代方案，我们将趋势设定为自回归积分滑动平均（ARIMA）过程，其脉冲响应函数遵循反映技术变革扩散过程的S型模式。我们利用美国战后季度数据，采用此类ARIMA过程构建并估计了不可观测成分ARIMA（UCARIMA）模型。研究发现，尽管我们的模型更为简约，但其拟合数据的效果与标准随机游走加AR(2)周期模型相当。此外，在我们的模型中，周期相对于趋势的方差具有极低的方差值。

title: A small volume reduction that melts down the market: Auctions with endogenous rationing
title_zh: 小规模减量引发市场崩盘：内生配给的拍卖
authors: Karl‐Martin Ehrhart, Ann-Katrin Hanke, Marion Ott
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Auctions with endogenous rationing have been introduced to stimulate competition. Such (procurement) auctions reduce the volume put out to tender when competition is low. This paper finds a strong negative effect of endogenous rationing on participation when bid-preparation is costly, counteracting the aim to stimulate competition. For multiple auctioneer's objectives mentioned in directives, we derive optimal mechanisms, which differ due to different evaluation of the tradeoff between participation and bid-preparation costs. Thus, the auctioneer needs to decide on an objective. However, reducing bid-preparation costs improves the optimal values of multiple objective functions.
abstract_zh: 内生配给拍卖被引入以刺激竞争。此类（采购）拍卖在竞争不足时会减少招标数量。本文发现，当投标准备成本较高时，内生配给对参与率产生显著的负向效应，这与刺激竞争的目标相悖。针对指令中提及的多种拍卖方目标，我们推导出最优机制，这些机制因对参与率与投标准备成本之间权衡的不同评估而存在差异。因此，拍卖方需要确定一个目标。然而，降低投标准备成本能够改善多个目标函数的最优值。

title: Knowledge Spillovers and the Growth of Local Industries
title_zh: 知识溢出与地方产业增长
authors: Mario Forni, Sergio Paba
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2003-03-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In this paper we investigate the nature and directions of inter‐industry dynamic linkages across Italian manufacturing sectors. We perform a very disaggregated analysis in order to identify, for each 3‐digit industry, which composition of industrial activity is more conducive to growth. We find that diversity matters for growth, but each industry needs its own diversity. We provide some evidence of clustering of industries based on dynamic externalities. We find that many spillovers occur within input‐output relationships. They often originate in downstream sectors favouring the growth of upstream industries. Lastly, the importance of spillovers does not depend on the technological intensity of the industry.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了意大利制造业部门间产业动态关联的性质与方向。我们通过高度细化的分析，识别出每个三位数行业中，何种产业活动组合更有利于增长。研究发现，多样性对增长具有重要影响，但每个行业需要其特定的多样性结构。我们提供了基于动态外部性的产业集聚证据，并发现许多溢出效应发生在投入产出关系内部，这些效应通常源于下游部门，并促进上游产业的增长。最后，溢出效应的重要性并不取决于行业的技术密集程度。

title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: DP21770 模糊归因：理论与证据
authors: Ricardo Alonso, Monica Martinez-Bravo, Gerard Padro i Miquel, Carlos Sanz, Silvia Vannutelli
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents' partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 责任清晰性是政治问责的核心要素。我们构建了一个存在模糊归因情境下贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并通过原创性调查检验其预测。研究表明，受访者的党派倾向、对公共医疗质量的评估以及关于哪级政府负责医疗服务的信念之间存在预测性关联：评估良好的选民将责任归于其偏好政党执政的层级，而评估不佳的选民则将责任归咎于其厌恶政党执政的层级。这种党派性的褒贬模式常被解读为动机性推理或党派偏见的证据，但在归因模糊条件下，它实际上可能源于理性贝叶斯更新。当同一政党同时掌控地区与中央政府时，此类党派性模式便不复存在。在告知受访者官方医疗质量信息的调查实验中，其更新方向与预测的党派性方向一致。模型与实证结果表明，当归因模糊时，党派先验信念极难被撼动。

title: Understanding Latin America's Fertility Decline: Age, Education, and Cohort Dynamics
title_zh: 理解拉丁美洲生育率下降：年龄、教育与队列动态
authors: InÃ©s, Berniell,, Raquel, FernÃ¡ndez,, Azul, MenduiÃ±a,, Onofri, Milagros
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the sharp decline in fertility across Latin America using both period and cohort measures. Combining Vital Statistics, Census microdata, and UN population data, we decompose changes in fertility by age, education, and joint age-education groups. We show that the decline in period fertility between 2000 and 2022 is driven primarily by reductions in within-group birth rates rather than by changes in population composition, with the largest contributions coming from younger and less-educated women. Comparing the cohort born in the mid 1950s and the one born in the mid 1970s, we find that the decline in completed fertility reflects not only delayed childbearing but also substantial reductions in the average number of children per woman. This is driven primarily by lower fertility among mothers rather than by rising childlessness. Our findings provide new evidence on the nature of Latin America's transition to below-replacement fertility and highlight several open questions for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文利用时期与队列两种度量指标，考察了拉丁美洲生育率的急剧下降。通过整合生命统计数据、人口普查微观数据及联合国人口数据，我们按年龄、教育程度以及年龄-教育联合分组对生育率变化进行了分解。研究表明，2000年至2022年间时期生育率的下降主要源于组内生育率的降低，而非人口结构变化，其中年轻且受教育程度较低的女性贡献最大。对比20世纪50年代中期与70年代中期出生的队列，我们发现终身生育率的下降不仅反映了生育推迟，更体现了每位女性平均生育数量的显著减少。这一变化主要由已育女性生育率降低驱动，而非无子女比例上升所致。本研究为拉丁美洲向低于更替水平生育率转型的特征提供了新证据，并揭示了未来研究中若干待解的关键问题。

title: Partisan Entrepreneurship
title_zh: 党派创业
authors: JOSEPH ENGELBERG, JORGE GUZMAN, RUNJING LU, WILLIAM MULLINS
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Republicans start more firms than Democrats. In a sample of 40 million party‐identified Americans between 2005 and 2017, we find that 5.5% of Republicans and 3.7% of Democrats become entrepreneurs. This partisan entrepreneurship gap is time‐varying—Republicans increase their relative entrepreneurship during Republican administrations and decrease it during Democratic administrations, amounting to a partisan reallocation of 170,000 new firms over our 13‐year sample. We find sharp changes in partisan entrepreneurship around the elections of President Obama and President Trump, with the strongest effects among the most politically active partisans: those that donate and vote.
abstract_zh: 共和党人比民主党人创办了更多企业。在2005年至2017年间4000万有党派归属的美国人的样本中，我们发现5.5%的共和党人和3.7%的民主党人成为企业家。这种党派创业差距具有时变性——共和党人在共和党执政期间相对创业率上升，在民主党执政期间下降，在我们的13年样本期内，这相当于17万家新企业的党派间重新配置。我们发现，在奥巴马总统和特朗普总统当选前后，党派创业行为发生了急剧变化，其中对政治参与度最高的党派成员（即捐款和投票者）影响最为显著。

title: The dynamics of costly norms
title_zh: 昂贵规范的形成机制
authors: Sam Jindani, H Peyton Young
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Social norms that are costly for individuals are held in place because of social pressure to conform. Historical examples include duelling in Europe and footbinding in China; contemporary examples include female genital cutting and wasteful consumption. Such norms exhibit varied dynamics. Some collapse after staying unchanged for centuries, while others erode gradually. Still others escalate gradually before collapsing. This paper develops a theoretical framework that explains these patterns in terms of different forces of social influence and lends itself to empirical estimation. The analysis can guide the design of policies aimed at mitigating or eliminating costly norms, and shows that some interventions can be counterproductive.
abstract_zh: 摘要 对个体而言代价高昂的社会规范之所以得以维系，源于社会遵从压力。历史案例包括欧洲的决斗传统与中国缠足习俗；当代案例则涵盖女性割礼与炫耀性消费。此类规范呈现出多元演变特征：有的在延续数百年后骤然瓦解，有的逐步消解，还有的则在崩溃前经历渐进升级过程。本文构建的理论框架通过阐释社会影响力的不同作用机制来解释上述模式，并适用于实证估计。该分析可为旨在缓解或消除代价高昂规范的政策设计提供指导，同时揭示某些干预措施可能适得其反。

title: Three reasons to price carbon under uncertainty: Accuracy of simple rules
title_zh: 不确定性下碳定价的三个理由：简单规则的准确性
authors: Ton Bremer, Christoph Hambel, Frederick Ploeg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: An easy‐to‐interpret rule for the optimal risk‐adjusted social cost of carbon is derived using perturbation analysis. This rule internalizes the adverse effects of global warming on the risk of recurring climate‐related disasters, the risk of irreversible cascading climate tipping points, and the usual effect on total factor productivity. It and its three components approximate the true numerical optimum well, especially if the small parameters (i.e., the share of damages in GDP, the sensitivity of the risk of disasters to temperature and the risk of climate tipping) are small enough and the discount rate is not too small. The rule is also accurate if applied to AK models with a different supply side, for example, with ongoing technical progress in fossil‐fuel production or multiple economic sectors. With a growth‐adjusted discount rate of 2%/year, the SCC is $172/tCO 2 , 70% of which is due to recurring climate disasters and 9% to climate tipping risk.
abstract_zh: 通过扰动分析，推导出一个易于解释的最优风险调整社会碳成本规则。该规则内化了全球变暖对以下方面的不利影响：气候相关灾害反复发生的风险、不可逆级联气候临界点风险，以及对全要素生产率的常规影响。该规则及其三个组成部分能够较好地近似真实数值最优解，尤其是当小参数（即GDP中损害份额、灾害风险对温度的敏感性以及气候临界点风险）足够小且贴现率不太低时。若将该规则应用于具有不同供给侧结构的AK模型（例如化石燃料生产持续技术进步或多经济部门模型），其准确性依然成立。在增长调整贴现率为每年2%的情况下，社会碳成本为172美元/吨二氧化碳，其中70%源于反复发生的气候灾害，9%源于气候临界点风险。

abstract: China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 reshaped global trade, reducing U.S. demand for Mexican manufactured goods and weakening Mexico's manufacturing employment. This study estimates how this trade‐induced decline affected migration and employment decisions among rural Mexicans. Using individual‐level panel data from the Mexican National Rural Household Survey (ENHRUM) and a long‐difference framework, we instrument manufacturing employment with regional exposure to Chinese import competition. Results show that a 10‐percentage‐point decline in manufacturing employment increased the probability of U.S. migration by 24 percentage points and U.S. nonagricultural employment by 17 points, with no significant effects on agricultural employment.
abstract_zh: 2001年中国加入世界贸易组织重塑了全球贸易格局，导致美国对墨西哥制成品的需求下降，进而削弱了墨西哥制造业的就业水平。本研究旨在估算这一贸易冲击引发的制造业就业萎缩对墨西哥农村人口迁移及就业决策的影响。基于墨西哥国家农村家庭调查（ENHRUM）的个体层面面板数据，采用长期差分框架，以各地区对中国进口竞争的暴露度作为制造业就业的工具变量。结果表明：制造业就业率每下降10个百分点，农村人口迁移至美国的概率增加24个百分点，在美国从事非农就业的概率上升17个百分点，而对农业就业未产生显著影响。

title: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?
title_zh: 医疗保险家庭健康欺诈：规模、地域与主体
authors: Liran Einav, Amy Finkelstein, Yunan Ji, Neale Mahoney, Gideon Moore
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it? We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.
abstract_zh: 医疗保险欺诈的规模有多大？欺诈者是谁？我们以医疗保险家庭健康服务（普遍认为欺诈高发领域）为研究对象，将受到联邦特别行动组起诉的家庭健康机构定义为欺诈机构。通过整合全美所有家庭健康机构的医疗保险索赔数据，以及手工收集的2009-2013年间九个联邦司法辖区特别行动组的起诉记录，我们训练机器学习模型，预测其余85个司法辖区中每家家庭健康机构若存在特别行动组时被起诉的概率。研究估算显示，2008年医疗保险家庭健康支出中有3.4%（约5.2亿美元）由欺诈性家庭健康机构开具账单。特别行动组的靶向性显著：其覆盖的九个司法辖区虽仅占家庭健康总支出的40%，却集中了65%的欺诈性支出。欺诈性家庭健康机构呈现显著特征：更依赖超高转诊量的医师，护理模式异常统一，且服务对象健康水平高于平均水平。

abstract: How will future climate change affect Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) in terms of migration and welfare? Can policymakers help SSA adapt to this process? I answer these questions with a quantitative framework that, coupled with rich spatial data and forecasts for the future climate, projects millions of climate migrants and unequal welfare losses across SSA. Investigating migration and trade liberalization as policy tools, I find persistent inequality in welfare losses if only migration barriers in SSA are reduced. Relaxing trade barriers addresses these distributional concerns, as do both policies combined. Yet, the policy mix is less effective in reducing aggregate losses due to inefficiencies arising from congestion externalities.
abstract_zh: 未来气候变化将如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民与福利？政策制定者能否帮助该地区适应这一过程？本文通过构建一个量化分析框架，结合丰富的空间数据与未来气候预测，揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲地区将出现数百万气候移民及不均衡的福利损失。在将移民与贸易自由化作为政策工具进行研究时发现，若仅降低撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民壁垒，福利损失的不平等现象将持续存在。放松贸易壁垒能够解决这些分配问题，而两项政策组合实施亦能达到同样效果。然而，由于拥挤外部性导致的效率损失，政策组合在减少总体损失方面的有效性有所降低。

abstract: We study the role of war bonds and inflation in post-WWII federal elections. After WWII, major bouts of inflation in 1946-48 and 1950-51 depressed the real returns of the bonds sold to households during the war. In a difference-in-differences framework, we find that counties with higher war bond purchases shifted their votes towards the Republican Party in postwar elections. To address the endogeneity of war bond purchases, we use an instrumental variables design, and obtain similar results. Bond ownership raised the saliency of inflation, and the severe rise in prices after the war triggered a backlash against the incumbent Democrats.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了二战后的战争债券与通货膨胀在联邦选举中的作用。二战后，1946-48年和1950-51年的两次重大通胀压低了战争期间向家庭出售债券的实际回报。在双重差分框架下，我们发现战争债券购买量更高的县在战后选举中投票转向共和党。为解决战争债券购买的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量设计，并得到类似结果。债券持有提高了通胀的显著性，战后物价的急剧上涨引发了选民对在任民主党人的强烈反对。
